title: Cigarettes and bottled beer
summary: Buy cigarettes and beer at the casino bar and watch your character smoke or drink.
notes: Sell $2 cigarettes and $5 bottled beers through the existing bar shop and inventory.
Animate three separately triggered puffs or sips per item with the player rig for everyone, including late joiners.
Preserve remaining puffs and sips through inventory storage, swaps and drops.
Apply existing intoxication rules once per bottle on its first sip and retain the immediate bar drink option.
